name: Redis · Round 1
domainSummary: An in-memory data-structure server offering low-latency access to strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets, streams, and other specialized structures, with expiration, cache, queue, event-processing, persistence, replication, and pub-sub patterns.
evidenceBoundary: Do not use red, Redis logos, stacked brand cubes, code, or literal data diagrams. Keep it a low compact fast-access pavilion with multiple storage behaviors.

researchSources.title: Redis data types
researchSources.use: Official native structures and caching, queuing, and event-processing uses.

researchSources.title: Redis persistence
researchSources.use: Official snapshot and append-only durability options.
